description: This file defines a repository interface for BankInfo entities, extending JpaRepository to provide database access methods, including a custom method to find bank info by bank code.

classes.name: BankInfoRepository
classes.description: A Spring Data JPA repository interface for BankInfo entities, enabling CRUD operations and custom lookup by bank code.

methods.name: findByBankCode
methods.description: Custom method to retrieve a BankInfo entity by its unique bank code, returning an Optional of BankInfo.
